reasoning_input.question_text: A population of bacteria grows according to P(t) = P₀ e^(kt). Given P(0) = 500 and P(3) = 1500, find k in exact log form and find the time t when population reaches 4500.

student_steps.content: Take natural log: 3k = ln(3) → k = (1/3) ln(3)

steps.description: Substitute t = 3 to form 1500 = 500 e^(3k) and obtain e^(3k) = 3
Solve for growth constant k = (1/3) ln(3)
Solve for t to get t = 6 hours
